notes.title: ROBO CATCHER ZERO is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

We're happy to announce that [i][b]Robo Catcher Zero[/b][/i], the demo of our upcoming game [i][b]Robo Catcher[/b][/i], is now available to download!
Available in French, English, Italian, Spanish and Chinese.


The demo is part of the [b]Creature Collector Steam Festival[/b] so you'll be able to play it from today to the 19th May.


Enjoy and don't hesitate to tell us what you think!


Cheers,
The Pixel Fortress Team
